summary: Following an alert regarding moisture contamination in Atlas Wire and Cable heavy-duty wiring harnesses, lot LOT-0017 built between 2027-02-22 and 2027-02-24 at Wacky Wheels San Antonio was placed on hold. Across 36 dealers, 86 unsold vehicles were stopped from sale, and 94 owners of sold vehicles were contacted.
decision_reason: The system acted because the confirmed incident resolved all identifiers and dates against the data, handbook validators passed, and the sandbox pre-flight check succeeded. The auditor also confirmed the quality hold was planned in full compliance with policy rules, satisfying the operational gates.
